nodes.label: Output port
nodes.sublabel: NDJSON on stdout · diagnostics on stderr

cards.title: One pipeline, many frontends — SKILL.md §1
items: one headless core, many frontends: the TUI, print mode, the resource subcommands, the RPC server and IDE bridges are clients of the same core
the engine knows nothing about terminals; the frontend decides the output, never the workflow
the command pipeline is always parse → core → output and exit code, so a headless run and an interactive run execute the same use case

cards.title: The SDK is the only path — README.md §Why
items: a curl | jq happy path bypasses the SDK's retries, auth and error envelope — every network call rides SdkClient
the SdkClient port is declared by the core and implemented by the generated SDK, so the core never imports the client module
every request carries the correlation id, which ends up in the logs and in the error output

cards.title: Retries map to exit codes — references/cli-contract.md §3
items: 8 rate limited — honor Retry-After from the response; 9 network, timeout or offline; 10 server error
the retry budget is bounded and every failure ends in exactly one exit code, so a CI script can branch on it
the error kind → exit code mapping is an exhaustive switch: a new kind is a compile error and a contract change

cards.title: Stream mode — references/cli-contract.md §2
items: stream-json is newline-delimited JSON: one versioned event per line, flushed per event, and no other text on stdout
the events are start, progress, result and error; each carries a session id and a payload
unknown event types are ignored by consumers, additive changes stay within v, and a breaking change bumps it
print mode (-p) is the agent and CI path: one shot, no TUI, the final text or JSON only
